item.title: An Amphiphilic Proton Donor Decouples Acidity from Interfacial Reactivity for Lithium-Mediated Ammonia Synthesis
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 TFE decouples acidity from interfacial reactivity in Li-NRR, suppressing parasitic hydrogen evolution despite high acidity via fluorinated interfacial passivation and a crystalline LiF-rich SEI. Blending with ethanol optimizes proton activity, achieving 59.0% Faradaic efficiency in flow and 82.8% at high pressure. This establishes proton-donor engineering as a strategy to tune SEI nanostructure for selective ammonia synthesis.
🏷 Li-NRR · ammonia synthesis · proton donor · SEI · TFE

💡 This study uniquely links anion site disorder to ion dynamics versus thermal transport in Li₆PS₅Br, showing disorder enhances Li⁺ diffusion but leaves thermal conductivity unchanged at ~0.4 W·m⁻¹·K⁻¹. The finding that diffuson-like modes govern heat transport, validated by bridging molecular dynamics with mesoscale porosity modeling, advances understanding of thermal management in solid-state batteries.

item.title: Molecular‐Bridging Interfacial Engineering to Reinforce Li‐Rich Cathodes
item.description:
این مقاله با مهندسی بین‌سطحی پل‌زنی مولکولی، پوشش یکنواخت و فشرده لیتیوم سیلیکات را روی کاتدهای غنی از لیتیوم ایجاد کرده و پایداری چرخه را بهبود می‌بخشد.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces in situ molecular-bridging interfacial engineering to form a uniform, compact ~2 nm lithium silicate layer on Li-rich cathodes via electrostatic self-assembly. The bridges homogenize surface electric fields and reinforce interfacial stability, yielding 22.7% better capacity retention after 200 cycles and superior rate capability. It offers a rational design strategy for high-energy-density cathodes.

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work reveals that stronger additive adsorption does not always improve Zn reversibility; excessive adsorption impedes Zn²⁺ kinetics. Using protonated aminopyridines, it establishes an interaction-matching principle balancing interfacial protection and deposition kinetics, achieving 99.37% CE over 700 cycles and 96.63% capacity retention after 2000 cycles in Zn–I₂ batteries.
🏷 zinc metal anode · electrolyte additive · aminopyridine · Zn-I2 battery · interfacial adsorption

item.title: Targeted Modular Design of Rollable Polymer Dielectrics for High Efficiency Energy Storage Under Harsh Condition
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 A four-block modular polymer design balances thermal, mechanical, and electrical properties, overcoming longstanding trade-offs. It achieves 8.5 J/cm³ at 150°C and 6.4 J/cm³ at 200°C with >90% efficiency and 40% strain at break, enabling roll-to-roll large-area film fabrication without performance loss. This universal framework links molecular structure to macroscopic multifunctional requirements for harsh-condition energy storage.
🏷 polymer dielectric · capacitive energy storage · high temperature · roll-to-roll · modular design
